text:
maria: heads up — we're seeing ~30 leads this morning that never got an owner assigned (30m+). looks like HubSpot -> Salesforce owner sync is intermittently failing on some routes. SLA target is 15m. anyone on call to triage?

kevin: on it. can you paste a couple example hubspot URLs / ids so i can trace the webhook logs?

maria: here are two: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345 and https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12367. the `hubspot_owner_id` is blank on both. enrichment (Clearbit) also lagged for these which might be related.

anya: temporary idea — can we route unassigned leads to an "inbound-temp" queue via a HS workflow so sales still gets notified instead of dropping into limbo? prefer quick patch over losing leads.

jordan: i can spin up a quick workflow. plan: 1) if HubSpot Owner = empty -> set Owner to `round_robin(inbound-sales)` 2) add a 10m delay + check: if still unassigned -> post to #sales-escalations and create SF case. snippet for workflow action: ```Set property: Owner = {{round_robin::inbound-sales}}``` 

sam: i'll run a TTA (time-to-assign) check for last 48h and return median/95th. SQL i'll run: ```SELECT lead_id, created_at, assigned_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, assigned_at) as tta FROM leads WHERE created_at > now() - interval 48 hour;``` back in ~20m.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: hubspot-workflows/assign-fix v2 -> staging by @jordan

kevin: for permanent fix we should: 1) audit webhook retry logic (we've seen 503 -> no retry in a small window), 2) add owner mapping test in integration tests, 3) ensure enrichment race doesn't clobber owner field when enrichment completes. also add a fallback escalation if owner is still empty after 10 minutes.

maria: +1 on escalation. SLA reminder: product expects <15m to owner. if we miss consistently we need to notify sales leadership.

jordan: pushed the HS workflow to prod, enabled rotation. changed mapping: HS `owner` -> SF `OwnerId` and added a guard to not overwrite if OwnerId already set. ``deploy note: workflow id 98765``

ops-bot: Deploy complete: hubspot-workflows/assign-fix v2 -> production (success)

sam: quick numbers from the run: median TTA last 48h before fix = 28m, after immediate patch (1h window) = 6m. 95th dropped from 95m -> 22m. i'll drop the query + csv in the #analytics channel.

kevin: nice work. next steps: 1) logs-based alert for webhook failure spikes, 2) add unit/integration test for owner sync, 3) schedule a short postmortem next week to figure root cause.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging @anya for communications update to sales ops and @kevin for PM follow-up. please update this thread if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

anya: will prep a short note for sales ops + a one-pager for leadership if the postmortem shows systemic risk.

kevin: putting a 2-week ticket on roadmap to harden the sync and add automated retries.

maria: closing loop — initial drop fixed and monitoring in place. if you see stray leads, reply here with example ids. cheers.
